hooks.command: f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$f" in *CLAUDE.md|*AGENTS.md|*PLAN.md|*PROGRESS.md|*doc*reference*.md) out=$(bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/doc-lint.sh") || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

j=$(cat); case "$j" in *doc-lint*) exit 0 ;; esac; if echo "$j" | grep -qE 'sed -i|tee |>>?[^&]*\.md|cp |mv ' && echo "$j" | grep -qE 'CLAUDE\.md|AGENTS\.md|PLAN\.md|PROGRESS\.md|doc.{0,4}reference'; then out=$(bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/doc-lint.sh") || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi
